translations.web: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”
translations.bsb: “As you say,” replied the steward. “But only the one who is found with the cup will be my slave, and the rest of you shall be free of blame.”
translations.kjv: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
translations.asv: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my bondman; and ye shall be blameless.
